props.title: Thanks, it's yours
props.lead: Bought it in Soju? Go back to Soju; it is already installing. Bought it on this site? Press the button below and Soju installs it.

props.label: Install in Soju
props.missing: Don't have Soju yet? [Download Soju](../#install), open it once, then press the button again.

props.text: 소주에서 사셨다면 이미 설치되고 있습니다. 이 사이트에서 사셨다면 위의 **소주에서 설치하기** 버튼을 누르세요. 소주가 알아서 받아 설치합니다.
Windows: the receipt email from Polar links the Windows zip. On another Mac, sign in to Soju with Apple or Google using the email you paid with.
